_comment: Cross-repository conformance vector for the Router-owned
openai-messages-json.v1 canonicalization. Generated by EXECUTING the
Router authority's own canonicalize_openai_messages() at the exact SHA
A test that recomputes 'expected_sha256' with the AgentReview
implementation would restate the implementation, not discriminate it.

generation.method: git archive <sha> | tar -x; import app.agent_router.inference_receipt; canonicalize_openai_messages(messages)

discriminates: separators=(',',':') -- default separators would add spaces
utf-8 encoding      -- any other codec changes the digest
message array order -- reversing the two messages changes the digest
role/content values -- both participate in the canonical text

messages.name: agentreview
messages.content: Revise apenas o conteúdo fornecido. Café ≠ cafe.
